decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  31st August 201026th July 2010 (drawing numbers 1364a-01/KG Rev B, 1364a-02/KG Rev A and 1364a-03/KG Rev B ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 0900 and 2300 Monday to Saturday and 0900 to 2200 Sundays and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 0700 and 1700 Monday to Friday  nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - Before the use hereby permitted is brought into operation, details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the premises and the flat above shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented before the use commences and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 6 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided in accordance with the approved drawings before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:(a)	A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the site.(b)	The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one meter above eaves level or one meter above openable windows of nearby properties.(c)	The ducting shall be circular.(d)	The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.(e)	The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.(f)	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.(g)	The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
Condition : 7 - There shall be no takeaway service provided from the premises without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - A bacterial or enzyme dosing unit shall be fitted on all waste discharge points from kitchen sinks and floor drains prior to discharging to the public sewerage system and shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order.

Condition : 9 - Drainage serving kitchens in commercial hot food premises should be fitted with a grease separator as detailed in the Building Regulations 2000, Approved Document H (Drainage and waste disposal) complying with prEN 1825-1 and designed in accordance with prEN 1825-2 or other effective means of grease removal. It is an offence under section 111 of The Water Industry Act 1991 to allow any substance which may interfere with the free flow of the sewer to pass into the public drainage system. The legislation can be viewed at http://www.opsi.gov.uk/. Further information can be found on the Thames Water Website http://www.thameswater.co.uk/cps/rde/xchg/corp/hs.xsl/6877.htm
Condition : 10 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times 0900-2100 Monday to Sunday.

Condition : 11 - The use shall not commence until the secure storage area within the site to house not less than two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins has been made available as shown on the approved drawings, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week. Waste shall be removed as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal weekly collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.

Condition : 12 - The outbuildings hereby approved shall only be used for storage purposes ancillary to No 10a Spring Grove Road and shall not be used separately for residential, retail, business, office or industrial use.
description: Change of use of ground floor from A1 (retail) to A3 (restaurant), erection of a single storey extension and detached single storey outbuilding, installation of fume extraction ducting, and alterations to the shop front.
